page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred above the text. No page number, catchword only at the bottom right ("De"), no marginal notes.

main_text.l: tradendis ita sum versatus, ut ex
rursum res, vel αὐτολεξεὶ[?], vel per bo-
que ita apud animum statuere tu-
nus esse, si quis ex Bibliis petat
nim fit, ut iuventus reddat sibi

page.notes: The first word "tegrè" is a fragment from the previous page; its first letter is uncertain (possibly an ae ligature). Greek words αὐτολεξεὶ and ἱμα ἢ ποδήρη are uncertain in their accents and letters. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. No page number is printed.
